value.answer: Same routine every time helps most, the same steps in the same order (bath, book, song, lights off), so his body starts to know what comes next. Dim the room and keep it quiet, and aim for the sleepy window before he's overtired, since overtired kids often fight sleep harder. Putting him down drowsy but still awake can help him learn to settle himself too. How old is he? The tips shift a bit depending on age.
